Hi Sam — thanks, got the form and W-9. Quick answers and next steps below.

1) Verification docs
- We prefer a voided check or a bank letter for ACH setup. The completed bank form helps but AP requires at least one proof of account ownership. A scanned voided check or a bank statement page (redact balances if necessary) will work.

2) Remittance / PO mapping
- Redwood's AP platform supports a structured remit field that maps to invoice lines. When you submit invoices, please include the exact PO token (e.g., PO-1234) in the invoice remittance reference field — that allows our ERPs to auto-match. If you cannot populate the structured field, include the PO on the first line of the invoice body and in the invoice subject.

3) Preferred payment method
- ACH is perfect. For wires, we also need the SWIFT/BIC plus intermediary bank details if applicable.

Next steps (what I'll do):
- I'll attach the vendor onboarding checklist for your reference and route this to AP for account creation.
- Marissa (cc) will kick off the verification and schedule micro-deposit testing once we have the voided check.
- Jonas (cc) will confirm the remittance mapping config in our billing system after the vendor record is created.

If you can send the voided check and confirm the beneficiary legal name exactly as it should appear on the invoice (company name + DBAs if any), we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Redwood Inference
